usages.label: 天气
usages.sentence: It is very cold in winter, so we wear warm clothes.
usages.sentenceZh: 冬天很冷，所以我们穿暖和的衣服。
usages.rephrase: In winter, the temperature is low, so we put on warm clothes.

usages.label: 食物
usages.sentence: I don't like cold milk; I prefer it hot.
usages.sentenceZh: 我不喜欢冷牛奶，我更喜欢热的。
usages.rephrase: I like hot milk better than cold milk.

usages.label: 态度
usages.sentence: She gave me a cold look and walked away.
usages.sentenceZh: 她冷冷地看了我一眼，然后走开了。
usages.explain: cold 也可以形容不友好的态度。
usages.rephrase: She looked at me without warmth and left.

derivatives.exampleSentence: He spoke coldly to the stranger.
derivatives.exampleZh: 他冷淡地对陌生人说话。

induct.title: 形容词变副词
induct.tip: 大多数形容词加 -ly 变成副词，修饰动词。

examExamples.readSentence: His teacher treated him coldly at first.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 他的老师起初对他很冷淡。

examTarget.note: 考点：形容词变副词修饰动词 treated。

vocabUnits.defA2: the physical or mental energy needed to do something
vocabUnits.defReadAloud: the physical or mental energy needed to do something

usages.label: 努力
usages.sentence: She made a great effort to finish the race.
usages.sentenceZh: 她付出了巨大的努力来完成比赛。
usages.rephrase: She tried very hard to finish the race.

usages.label: 尝试
usages.sentence: It was his first effort to cook dinner.
usages.sentenceZh: 这是他第一次尝试做晚饭。
usages.rephrase: He tried to cook dinner for the first time.

usages.label: 不费力
usages.sentence: He passed the exam without much effort.
usages.sentenceZh: 他没费多大力气就通过了考试。
usages.explain: effort 常与 without 连用表示轻松。
usages.rephrase: He passed the exam easily.

derivatives.note: 固定短语，表示努力做某事
derivatives.exampleSentence: You should make an effort to learn English every day.
derivatives.exampleZh: 你应该每天努力学英语。

induct.title: 努力相关短语
induct.tip: make an effort 后接 to do 不定式。

examExamples.readSentence: He made a great effort and finally became a famous strategist.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 他付出了巨大的努力，最终成为著名的战略家。

examTarget.note: 考点：名词作宾语，make a great effort 固定搭配。

vocabUnits.defA2: used to refer to a male person or animal
vocabUnits.defReadAloud: used to refer to a male person or animal

usages.label: 代词主格
usages.sentence: He is my best friend.
usages.rephrase: That boy is my best friend.

usages.label: 泛指
usages.sentence: He who laughs last laughs best.
usages.sentenceZh: 笑到最后的人笑得最好。
usages.rephrase: The person who laughs last laughs best.

usages.label: 动物
usages.sentence: He is a strong dog.
usages.explain: he 也可用于雄性动物。
usages.rephrase: That dog is strong.

derivatives.note: he 的反身代词，表示他自己
derivatives.exampleSentence: He taught himself to play the guitar.

induct.title: 反身代词
induct.tip: 反身代词用于主语和宾语相同的情况。

examExamples.readSentence: He remembered the shame he had suffered himself.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 他记得自己遭受的耻辱。

examTarget.note: 考点：反身代词强调主语本身。

usages.label: 身体疼痛
usages.sentence: The cut on his finger was very painful.
usages.explain: painful 形容引起疼痛的事物。
usages.rephrase: His finger hurt a lot because of the cut.

usages.label: 情感痛苦
usages.sentence: It was painful to say goodbye to her.
usages.explain: painful 也可指情感上的痛苦。
usages.rephrase: Saying goodbye to her made him sad.

usages.label: 困难经历
usages.sentence: Learning a new language can be painful.
usages.sentenceZh: 学习一门新语言可能会很痛苦。
usages.explain: painful 形容困难且不愉快的经历。
usages.rephrase: Learning a new language is hard and not fun.

derivatives.note: 去掉 -ful 变成名词，表示疼痛
derivatives.exampleSentence: He felt a sharp pain in his leg.

induct.title: 形容词变名词
induct.tip: 以 -ful 结尾的形容词去掉 -ful 常得到名词。

examExamples.readSentence: The pain was nothing compared to the shame of failure.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 这疼痛与失败的耻辱相比算不了什么。

examTarget.note: 考点：名词作主语，pain 表示疼痛。

vocabUnits.defA2: to give money for something you buy
vocabUnits.defReadAloud: to give money for something you buy

usages.label: 付钱
usages.sentence: I need to pay for the book.
usages.rephrase: I have to give money for the book.

usages.label: 支付账单
usages.sentence: She pays the rent every month.
usages.explain: pay 后直接接账单或费用。
usages.rephrase: She gives money for the rent each month.

usages.label: 注意
usages.sentence: You must pay attention in class.
usages.sentenceZh: 你必须在课堂上注意听讲。
usages.explain: pay attention 是固定短语，表示注意。
usages.rephrase: You should listen carefully in class.

derivatives.note: pay 前加 to 构成不定式，常作目的状语
derivatives.exampleSentence: He stopped to pay for the ticket.

induct.title: 不定式作目的状语
induct.tip: 不定式 to do 常表示做某事的目的。

examExamples.readSentence: He wanted to pay attention to the lesson.

examTarget.note: 考点：不定式作宾语，want to do 结构。

vocabUnits.defA2: to make a hole in something using a sharp point
vocabUnits.defReadAloud: to make a hole in something using a sharp point

usages.label: 刺穿
usages.sentence: The needle pierced the cloth easily.
usages.explain: pierce 表示用尖锐物刺穿。
usages.rephrase: The needle made a hole in the cloth.

usages.label: 穿孔
usages.sentence: She pierced her ears to wear earrings.
usages.explain: pierce 也可指在身体上穿孔。
usages.rephrase: She made holes in her ears for earrings.

usages.label: 穿透
usages.sentence: The light pierced the darkness.
usages.explain: pierce 可比喻光线或声音穿透。
usages.rephrase: The light went through the darkness.

derivatives.note: pierce 的过去分词，用于被动语态
derivatives.exampleSentence: The balloon was pierced by a pin.

induct.title: 一般过去时被动语态
induct.tip: was/were + 过去分词构成被动语态。

examExamples.readSentence: His thigh was pierced many times.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 他的大腿被刺了很多次。

examTarget.note: 考点：被动语态，主语 thigh 承受动作。

vocabUnits.defA2: to get something that someone gives or sends to you
vocabUnits.defReadAloud: to get something that someone gives or sends to you

usages.label: 收到礼物
usages.sentence: I received a gift from my mother.
usages.sentenceZh: 我收到了妈妈的一份礼物。
usages.rephrase: My mother gave me a gift, and I got it.

usages.label: 接受教育
usages.sentence: He received a good education.
usages.explain: receive 可接抽象名词如 education。
usages.rephrase: He got a good education.

usages.label: 接待
usages.sentence: The hotel received many guests.
usages.rephrase: The hotel had many guests.

induct.title: 规则动词过去式
induct.tip: 大多数动词加 -ed 构成过去式，以 e 结尾加 -d。

examExamples.readSentence: He received a book on military strategy.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 他收到了一本军事策略书。

examTarget.note: 考点：一般过去时，动作发生在过去。

vocabUnits.defA2: a feeling of being embarrassed or guilty because of something wrong
vocabUnits.defReadAloud: a feeling of being embarrassed or guilty because of something wrong

usages.label: 羞愧感
usages.sentence: He felt shame for lying to his parents.
usages.sentenceZh: 他因为对父母撒谎而感到羞愧。
usages.rephrase: He felt bad because he lied to his parents.

usages.label: 耻辱
usages.sentence: It is a shame to waste food.
usages.explain: shame 可表示令人遗憾或可耻的事。
usages.rephrase: Wasting food is a bad thing.

usages.label: 丢脸
usages.sentence: She brought shame to her family.
usages.explain: shame 可指带来耻辱的人或事。
usages.rephrase: She made her family feel ashamed.

derivatives.note: shame 的形容词，表示感到羞愧的
derivatives.exampleSentence: He was ashamed of his mistake.
derivatives.exampleZh: 他为自己的错误感到羞愧。

induct.title: 名词变形容词
induct.tip: 有些名词加 -y 或 -ed 变成形容词。

examExamples.readSentence: The shame of failure drove him to work harder.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 失败的耻辱驱使他更加努力。

examTarget.note: 考点：名词作宾语，the shame of... 结构。

usages.label: 某物
usages.sentence: I want something to eat.
usages.explain: something 表示不确定的某物。
usages.rephrase: I want some food.

usages.label: 重要的事
usages.sentence: There is something I need to tell you.
usages.rephrase: I have an important thing to tell you.

usages.label: 大约
usages.sentence: He is something like 30 years old.
usages.rephrase: He is about 30 years old.

usages.label: 醒来
usages.sentence: I usually wake up at 7 o'clock.
usages.rephrase: I get out of bed at 7 o'clock.

usages.label: 叫醒
usages.sentence: Please wake me at 6 in the morning.
usages.explain: wake 可作及物动词表示叫醒。
usages.rephrase: Please make me get up at 6 in the morning.

usages.label: 唤醒记忆
usages.sentence: The song woke old memories.
usages.sentenceZh: 这首歌唤起了旧日的记忆。
usages.rephrase: The song made me remember old times.

derivatives.note: wake 的形容词，表示醒着的

induct.title: 动词变形容词
induct.tip: 有些动词加 a- 前缀变成形容词。

examExamples.readSentence: He stayed awake and kept reading.

examTarget.note: 考点：形容词作表语，stay awake 保持清醒。

vocabUnits.defA2: having a pleasant temperature, not cold
vocabUnits.defReadAloud: having a pleasant temperature, not cold

usages.label: 天气
usages.sentence: It is warm in spring.
usages.rephrase: Spring has nice temperatures.

usages.label: 食物
usages.sentence: The soup is still warm.
usages.rephrase: The soup is not cold.

usages.label: 温暖的感觉
usages.sentence: She gave me a warm hug.
usages.sentenceZh: 她给了我一个温暖的拥抱。
usages.explain: warm 也可形容情感温暖。
usages.rephrase: She hugged me in a friendly way.

usages.label: 时间单位
usages.sentence: There are 12 months in a year.
usages.rephrase: A year has 12 months.

usages.label: 年龄
usages.sentence: She is ten years old.
usages.rephrase: She is ten.

usages.label: 年度
usages.sentence: The new year begins in January.
usages.rephrase: The new year starts in January.

derivatives.note: year 加 's 表示一年的
derivatives.exampleSentence: We had a year's supply of food.
derivatives.exampleZh: 我们有一年的食物供应。

induct.title: 名词所有格
induct.tip: 表示时间名词加 's 表示‘...的’。

examExamples.readSentence: He remembered the year's shame he had suffered.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 他记得那一年遭受的耻辱。

examTarget.note: 考点：名词所有格，表示一年的。
